articles.title: Q2 Results Today Live: HAL, Vi, Hitachi, Alkem Lab, NMDC, BDL, Page Ind, IRCTC, Manappuram Finance, Ola Electric to announce Q2 results, Tata Power, Hindustan Copper, GRSE, Power Mech, Lalitha Jewellery, MIDHANI in focus
articles.summary: On November 12, 2026, several prominent Indian companies are announcing their Q2 FY27 financial results. Notably, Hindustan Aeronautics (HAL), a crucial public sector enterprise in India's defence and aerospace sector, is among them. Aspirants should follow such updates as they offer insights into the economic health and operational performance of key strategic industries, reflecting national industrial capabilities and progress in defence manufacturing.

articles.title: How Megaspeed built a network in Singapore and Malaysia to move $7.5 billion of Nvidia chips to Chinese companies
articles.summary: Nvidia is embroiled in a chip-smuggling controversy involving Singapore-based cloud computing provider, Megaspeed. Megaspeed is suspected of illicitly funneling Nvidia chips, sparking concerns over the supply chain and potential circumvention of export regulations for advanced semiconductor technology. This investigation highlights challenges in controlling the distribution of high-value tech components and their end-use.

articles.title: Fantasy Football Rankings: Hayden Winks' RB Blueprint for Week 10
articles.summary: "The Blueprint" is introduced as a weekly column detailing a systematic approach to construct highly accurate rankings, specifically for categories like RB and WR. The column will also feature a broader combination analysis, showcasing its comprehensive ranking strategy.
